verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official quickstart for installing and initializing the gcloud CLI and shows the exact install command, which covers the first step of zero-to-deploy onboarding. Nothing in the pack shows a quickstart that goes all the way to a running deployed service, or any timing evidence for the under-an-hour claim. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end deploy quickstart (e.g. deploying a service to a running URL), exact deploy commands, evidence of time-to-first-deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown

citations.quote: This quickstart describes the recommended method to install and initialize the Google Cloud CLI.
